paragraphs.zh: 一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法
paragraphs.notes: Title of the invention, printed centred and in bold at the head of the description. No paragraph marker is printed for it, so marker is null. This is the first page of the description proper (1/17), so the title is body content here and not a running header.
Section heading, bold, no paragraph marker printed.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明属于精细化工中间体合成领域，涉及一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，具体涉及2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸和2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法。
paragraphs.en: The present invention belongs to the field of the synthesis of fine chemical intermediates, and relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, and specifically relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid and 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid.
paragraphs.notes: Two specific targets are named here, differing only in the alkoxy group: the 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy one and the (RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxy one. The (RS) prefix is printed, so the tetrahydrofuranyl target is explicitly the racemate. The locants inside 2,2,2- are printed with half-width commas while the clause separators are full-width; both are preserved as printed. The generic name uses the Chinese for alkoxymethyl, which is the group drawn as CH2-O-R, with R undefined, in the structure at [0006].
Section heading, bold, no paragraph marker printed. Everything from here to the end of the page is background, not the invention's own route.

paragraphs.zh: 对羟基苯基丙酮酸双氧化酶(4-hy-droxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase，HPPD)是目前最重要的除草剂作用靶标之一，HPPD抑制剂类除草剂在全球18类除草剂中占有重要地位，销售额占全球除草剂市场的5.8％，此类药剂以广谱、高效、抗性发展缓慢著称。HPPD抑制剂类除草剂具有相同作用机理，但结构上不完全相关，有三酮类、吡唑酮类和异噁唑酮类。环磺酮(Tembotrione)和呋喃磺草酮(Tefuryltrione)是HPPD系列三酮类除草剂，结构式如下：
paragraphs.en: 4-Hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (4-hy-droxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase, HPPD) is one of the most important herbicide targets of action at present. HPPD-inhibitor herbicides occupy an important position among the world's 18 classes of herbicide, with sales making up 5.8% of the global herbicide market; agents of this class are noted for their broad spectrum, high efficacy and slow development of resistance. HPPD-inhibitor herbicides share the same mode of action but are not entirely related in structure, comprising the triketones, the pyrazolones and the isoxazolones. Tembotrione and tefuryltrione are triketone herbicides of the HPPD series; their structural formulae are as follows:
paragraphs.notes: The English enzyme name inside the parentheses is printed with a spurious hyphen, as 4-hy-droxyphenylpyruvate, and is transcribed verbatim including that hyphen; it reads as a line-break hyphen the typesetter left in mid-line. The PDF text layer renders a double space between that word and dioxygenase, which is a justification artifact; a single space is recorded, matching the image. The 5.8 percent figure is printed with a full-width percent sign and the list separators are the Chinese enumeration mark, both preserved. Each of the two herbicides is given by Chinese common name immediately glossed with its Latin name in parentheses, so the identification of the two drawn structures is made by the page itself and is not imported from outside it. The three structural classes translate as triketones, pyrazolones and isoxazolones.

This paragraph marker is printed at the left margin alongside a drawing and carries no text at all. Its entire content is the pair of structural formulae recorded as drawings[0]. Recorded here as an empty paragraph so that document order stays recoverable.

paragraphs.zh: 环磺酮由拜耳公司于2007年独立开发，环磺酮其活性高于硝磺草酮，对作物安全，主要用于玉米田杂草防治，具有广泛的除草谱；呋喃磺草酮由拜耳、HOKKO(日本北兴)和Zen-Noh(日本农协经营的国际贸易公司)联合开发，于2008年在日本上市，呋喃磺草酮主要用于水稻田杂草防治。环磺酮2009年到2014年间的复合年增长率高达51.6％，呋喃磺草酮2009年到2014年间的复合年增长率也高达20.1％，此外这两个药剂的专利将于2019年9月到期，到时将迎来一轮发展的机会。
paragraphs.en: Tembotrione was developed independently by Bayer in 2007; tembotrione has higher activity than mesotrione and is safe to crops, is used mainly for weed control in maize fields, and has a broad herbicidal spectrum. Tefuryltrione was developed jointly by Bayer, HOKKO (Hokko of Japan) and Zen-Noh (an international trading company operated by the Japanese agricultural cooperatives), was launched in Japan in 2008, and is used mainly for weed control in paddy rice fields. The compound annual growth rate of tembotrione between 2009 and 2014 reached 51.6%, and that of tefuryltrione between 2009 and 2014 also reached 20.1%; furthermore the patents on these two agents will expire in September 2019, at which time a round of development opportunity will arrive.
paragraphs.notes: A third herbicide is named here in prose only and is never drawn on this page: its Chinese common name corresponds to mesotrione, and that identification rests on the standard Chinese common name, not on anything printed on p04. Company names HOKKO and Zen-Noh are printed in Latin script with Chinese glosses in parentheses; the glosses are translated literally. The second clause is loose Chinese, repeating the subject with a redundant possessive pronoun before the predicate, and is translated as written rather than tidied. Both growth-rate figures and the 2019 expiry date are commercial claims taken from background text and are recorded, not checked.

paragraphs.zh: 化合物2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸是此系列化合物的关键中间体，结构式如下：
paragraphs.en: The compound 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is the key intermediate of this series of compounds; its structural formula is as follows:
paragraphs.notes: The name uses the generic Chinese for alkoxymethyl, matching the title. The structure that follows draws that group as CH2-O-R, with R undefined anywhere on this page.

As with [0003], this marker is printed at the left margin alongside a drawing and carries no text. Its entire content is the single generic structure recorded as drawings[1]. Recorded as an empty paragraph to preserve document order.

paragraphs.zh: CN105601548A、CN104292137A、US6376429、CN1364160A和CN1323292A等均公开了以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯为原料，在碱作用下与相应的醇或直接与相应的醇钠反应制备得到目标物甲酯，在进一步皂化制备得到2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的方法，反应式如下：
paragraphs.en: CN105601548A, CN104292137A, US6376429, CN1364160A and CN1323292A all disclose a process in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used as the starting material and is reacted, under the action of a base, with the corresponding alcohol, or directly with the corresponding sodium alkoxide, to prepare the methyl ester of the target compound, which is then further saponified to give 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the reaction scheme is as follows:
paragraphs.notes: In the saponification clause the page prints the character meaning "at, in" where the character meaning "then, further" is clearly intended; transcribed verbatim in zh and translated according to the evident sense, with this note flagging it. This is the prior-art route, attributed to five named prior publications, one of which, CN104292137A, is the reference run in this repository. The sodium alkoxide is written literally as the sodium salt of the alcohol. The page ends immediately after the colon, so the promised reaction scheme is not on this page.

drawings.notes: Two separate single structures side by side with no arrow between them, so this is not a scheme. Each carries a printed Latin caption beneath it: Tembotrione on the left, Tefuryltrione on the right. The page is born-digital and every bond and atom label in both structures is crisp; all positions were read off the drawn ring and none was inferred from what the molecule ought to be. The two structures are identical except for the terminal group of the C3 side chain (CH2CF3 on the left, tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethyl on the right). The tetrahydrofuran C2 of the right-hand structure is a stereocentre and is drawn with two plain lines, no wedge and no hash and no configuration label, so the drawing specifies no configuration and the SMILES carries no stereo descriptor. Both are existing commercial herbicides cited in the background section as the products that motivate the work; neither is a step of the invention's route.

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st, the only structure in this drawing, left of centre
substituents: COOH at C1, drawn as HO-C(=O) with the hydroxyl written HO to the left and the double-bonded O above
CH2-O-R at C3, where R is a letter label that is not defined anywhere on this page

drawings.notes: A single generic (Markush) structure with no arrow. Every atom of the drawn skeleton is unambiguous, hence confidence high, but name and smiles are null because the substituent R at the end of the C3 side chain is an undefined variable: no R definition, no list of R values and no claim cross-reference appears anywhere on p04. Read only as far as the drawing goes, it is 2-chloro-3-[(R-oxy)methyl]-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid, which is a partial name and is therefore not recorded in the name field. The prose at [0005] calls the same species 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, consistent with R being an alkyl or substituted-alkyl group but not pinning it down. The substituent pattern here (COOH, Cl, CH2OR, SO2CH3 on four consecutive ring positions) is the same ring pattern as the aroyl half of both structures in drawings[0], read independently off this drawing rather than copied from it.

notes: First page of the description (1/17). Born-digital page with no scan noise: the prose and both drawings are crisp at the rendered resolution and nothing on the page is illegible, so page_confidence is high. The one genuine limit on this page is not legibility but content: the letter R in drawings[1] is an undefined variable, which is why that structure's name and smiles are null while its confidence stays high, since every drawn atom is certain. The Chinese transcription was checked character for character against the PDF text layer; the drawings section was read from the page image alone, because the text layer carries no bond or atom label from either drawing. Two typographic oddities in the original are preserved verbatim in zh and flagged in per-paragraph notes: the spurious hyphen inside the enzyme name at [0002], and the wrong homophone-adjacent character in the saponification clause at [0007]. Everything on p04 is background material; nothing here is the invention's own route. Note for downstream passes: this patent writes the Chinese common name of tembotrione with one character fewer than the form used in the reference run CN104292137A, so a string match on the Chinese common name across the two runs will fail even though the compound is the same.
